steps.label: THIS LESSON
steps.sub: wrap it in an API, then a container — callable over HTTP

caption: One endpoint is enough — this proves the pipeline runs as a real service, it doesn't need a full API surface.

code:
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
ENV ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=""
CMD ["uvicorn", "api.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
caption: Applies this path's Docker & AI Deployment course directly — packaging a Python AI app, env vars & secrets.

steps.label: ENV ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="" DOCUMENTS THE NEED
